title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Job description

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

description:
Localização: RJ-RIO DE JANEIRO, Rio de Janeiro, BR

Se você é apaixonado por pesquisar e desenvolver medicamentos e novas opções terapêuticas, movido por desafios, melhorias e tendências de mercado, comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos ao atuar com inovações, essa oportunidade é para você! #Vem Ser FQM

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Descrição Sumária

Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas para serem utilizadas pelo Controle de Qualidade para confirmar a qualidade das matérias-primas e dos produtos. Conduzir Estudos de Estabilidade a fim de determinar o prazo de validade dos produtos.

Local de trabalho: Jacaré/Rio de janeiro.

Principais atividades

  • Elaborar os protocolos e executar testes experimentais de desenvolvimento e/ou validação das metodologias analíticas para métodos de identificação, teor, uniformidade de conteúdo, dissolução e substâncias relacionadas;
  • Desenvolver metodologias indicativas de estabilidade e executar os testes de degradação forçada dos insumos farmacêuticos ativos e produtos;
  • Elaborar monografias de análise dos produtos, insumos e matérias primas;
  • Executar análises físico-químicas relacionadas aos estudos de estabilidade dos produtos;
  • Elaborar documentação dos produtos em estabilidade, emitindo laudos, pareceres e relatórios técnicos dos resultados observados;
  • Elaborar/Revisar procedimentos operacionais padrão dos equipamentos e atividades do setor de acordo com a demanda;
  • Elaborar o dossiê dos produtos e pesquisas sob responsabilidade de sua área de atuação, compilando todos os documentos relativos à condução das atividades de desenvolvimento analítico, visando a submissão na ANVISA.
  • Contribuir para investigações analíticas, “troubleshooting”, desvios e análises de tendência;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL) e diretrizes de integridade de dados.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino Superior.
  • Área: Farmácia, Química, Engenharia Química e afins.
  • Conhecimento em análises físico-químicas e análises instrumentais, tais como HPLC, CG, Espectrofotômetro UV-VIS, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento das normativas vigentes de medicamentos, suplementos alimentares e cosméticos.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Diferenciais

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

The Director of Clinical Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical services across multiple departments. The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams, optimize patient throughput, and foster collaboration among clinical and administrative stakeholders.

  • Direct multi-disciplinary teams to ensure effective execution of clinical workflows, service delivery, and compliance with institutional and regulatory standards.
  • Implement and monitor KPIs such as patient wait times, double-booking volume, appointment utilization rates, and provider panel sizes to drive operational efficiency.

  • Oversee scheduling systems, capacity planning, and resource allocation to maximize productivity and patient satisfaction.

  • Facilitate regular strategy sessions with senior leadership, department chairs, and finance teams to align clinical and financial priorities.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop clinical operations managers and support staff.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and patient-centered care.
  • Ensure staff compliance with policies, procedures, and performance standards.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Partner with finance teams to develop and manage budgets for clinical operations.
  • Monitor revenue cycle performance and implement strategies to optimize reimbursement.

Quality & Compliance

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilities

Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement

  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.g., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.g., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)

Early Detection Strategy

  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level

Strategic Implementation

  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field

Individual Contributors

  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.

About you

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus

Soft skills

  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.

Professional competencies

  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities

Technical skills

  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches

Education

  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred

Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Progress wouldn’t be possible without people; people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. Seek change, embrace new ideas, and explore all the opportunities we have to offer. Pursue progress and discover the extraordinary with us.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, nationality, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

This role requires excellent communication skills, full professional fluency in English, and the ability to clearly convey technical insights to clients in a way that informs and inspires decision‑making. This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Mexico, Brazil, Portugal, Spain or Pakistan.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security‑focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state‑of‑the‑art practices such as threat modeling, table‑top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open‑source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open‑source ecosystem.

Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security‑oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long‑term security response for the entire operating system and open‑source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.

Apply here if you are an exceptional security‑focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.

This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self‑discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role.

What you'll do

  • Define, implement, and document new security features
  • Lead security‑focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country‑specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Results‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Optional skills we also value

  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low‑level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. description:
MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA E-MULTI - AP 4.0 – SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião‑dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria com RQE;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021 , a saber:
  • RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.
    • Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).
    • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
    • Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.
    • Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB).
    • Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

title: Associate Director of Research Administration
description:
Associate Director of Research Administration

The Associate Director of Research Administration will oversee the College Research Administrators (CRAs) and departmental research administrators, ensuring effective pre- and post-award support for faculty. This role will be responsible for the training, oversight, and performance evaluation of research administrators across all colleges. The Associate Director will serve as the primary liaison between the Office of Research (OOR) and the Associate Deans, working to improve administrative efficiency and ensure compliance with federal and institutional policies.

Benefits

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant university culture

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises CRAs and departmental research administrators, ensuring consistent and effective research administration support.
  • Works closely with Deans, Associate Deans, and PIs to monitor and enhance grant support services.
  • Develops standardized departmental processes for pre- and post-award administration to be implemented university-wide.
  • Oversees the integration of existing departmental research administrators into the new centralized structure.

Nature And Scope

Reporting directly to the Director of Research Administration/AVP of Research Operations, the Associate Director will implement a centralized research administration model. This role will establish standardized workflows, ensure research administrators receive ongoing training, and work closely with Associate Deans and faculty to troubleshoot issues. The Associate Director will also lead monthly research administration meetings to facilitate training, updates, and process improvements.

Principal Accountabilities

Oversight & Management

  • Directly supervises CRAs and departmental research administrators, ensuring consistent and effective research administration support.
  • Works closely with Deans, Associate Deans, and PIs to monitor and enhance grant support services.
  • Develops standardized departmental processes for pre- and post-award administration to be implemented university-wide.
  • Oversees the integration of existing departmental research administrators into the new centralized structure.

Training & Professional Development

  • Develops and implements an onboarding program for newly hired and transitioning research administrators.
  • Ensures that all research administrators complete 12 hours of required training annually, covering:
    • Proposal development & sponsor guidelines
    • Budgeting & financial management
    • Workday grants system workflows
    • Federal compliance & university policies
  • Leads monthly 3‑hour research administration meetings, providing updates, training, and addressing concerns raised by administrators and faculty.

Performance Management & Feedback

  • Works with Associate Deans to evaluate CRA and departmental research administrator performance.
  • Develops and implements performance metrics for tracking research administration effectiveness across colleges.
  • Addresses faculty concerns regarding research administration support and identifies opportunities for process improvement.

Collaboration & Troubleshooting

  • Serves as the primary liaison between CRAs, departmental administrators, Associate Deans, Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), and Research Operations.
  • Identifies and resolves issues related to grant setup, payments, budgeting, and compliance.
  • Works with HR and Procurement to streamline grant‑related hiring and financial workflows.

Compliance & Policy Implementation

  • Ensures research administrators stay current with federal, state, and institutional policies affecting sponsored programs.
  • Provides updates and guidance on changes in grant regulations (e.g., NIH, NSF, DoE, 2 CFR 200).
  • Monitors research administration practices to ensure adherence to university and federal compliance requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Strong leadership skills in managing teams across multiple colleges.
  • Expertise in pre‑ and post‑award research administration within a university setting.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal grant regulations and institutional compliance policies.
  • Effective problem‑solving and the ability to streamline complex administrative workflows.
  • Excellent communication and training skills to support administrators and faculty.
  • Strong collaborative mindset with experience working across multiple stakeholders (faculty, deans, HR, finance, research operations).

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, research administration, public administration, finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of research administration experience, with pre‑ and post‑award management expertise.
  • Familiarity with federal funding agency policies (e.g., NIH, NSF, DoE, DOD grants & contracts).
  • Experience in supervising and training research administrators.
  • Strong knowledge of Workday Grants (or similar ERP), federal grant compliance, and university‑sponsored programs administration.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage process improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Research Administrator (CRA) or Certified Pre‑Award Research Administrator (CPRA) certification.
  • Experience working in an R1 university or large research‑intensive institution.

Expected Pay Range: $127,272 – $140,000

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Executive Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

Prioritizing Well‑being and Professional Growth

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Purpose of Job

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Howard University (HU) Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) has responsibility for the achievement of the strategic, operational, and financial goals of HU FPP. This position is responsible for the day‑to‑day operations and execution of the strategic vision for the HU FPP, including overseeing and directing organizational and physician alignment, operating and financial efficiency of clinical enterprises, practice management, revenue cycle services, expansion of referral sources, information technology and electronic health record management implementation, managed care contracting, and marketing and public relations.

This position is responsible for ensuring that high quality, innovative, and financially sustainable operations are in place and effectively managed to support HU FPP. The CEO of HU FPP will help to ensure that HU FPP is well‑positioned in a rapidly evolving and competitive environment through optimized and systematic physician practice management. Additionally, in conjunction with the management team, this position will lead efforts to collaborate with community healthcare providers to enhance patient access in the communities served by HU FPP.

Job Responsibilities

  • Profit and Loss (P&L) responsibility for the operations of HU FPP, including all aspects of effective operational and financial management and reporting, managed care contracting, and operational and capital budgeting.
  • Implement operational processes and drive efficiencies at HU FPP to reduce administrative burden for HU FPP physicians.
  • Develop and implement key initiatives to improve deficiencies ascertained through the evaluation of operations.
  • Collaborate with Physician Enterprise leadership to apply effective processes, practice management tools, and best practices to the management of HU FPP.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Join to apply for the ANALISTA DE PLANEJAMENTO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades

  • Analisar, interpretar, consolidar e apresentar os dados estatísticos referentes às metas quantitativas e qualitativas do Hospital.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo na área da saúde (exceto medicina);
  • Pós-graduação em saúde coletiva, saúde pública e/ou gestão em saúde;
  • Experiência em análise de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

title: Mix-media Video Editor
description:
Mix-media Video Editor (Video + Motion)


We are hiring a video editor who can own end-to-end content delivery across short‑form video, mixed media and motion‑driven social assets. This role is built for someone who lives in modern social feeds, understands what earns attention today, and can turn a simple script, reference, or raw footage into a finished piece that performs.


You will edit fast and bring daily creative momentum to Darkroom’s brand. While occasional longer edits still matter, the core of your work will be short‑form social content, performance‑minded cutdowns, and motion‑enhanced storytelling.


You will also help define how Darkroom shows up across platforms through consistent, high‑quality video output.


This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST zone. Candidates based in Portugal, Spain, and Brazil are encouraged to apply.


What You Will Do


Short‑form and social‑first editing



  • Edit and produce high‑volume, high‑quality short‑form content for Darkroom across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X.

  • Build “thumb‑stopping” edits that land quickly, hold attention, and deliver one clear takeaway.

  • Pull the strongest moments from raw footage, podcasts, webinars, events and internal shoots, then shape them into tight narratives.

  • Create platform‑specific versions of the same concept, including aspect ratio variations and multiple hooks for testing.

  • Deliver A and B variants to support creative learning and performance optimization.


Mixed media and motion design



  • Design and animate motion elements that elevate social edits, including kinetic typography, graphic transitions, and lightweight compositing.

  • Build mixed media layouts that combine video, stills, screen recordings, overlays, and design assets into one cohesive piece.

  • Develop reusable motion templates that speed up production without sacrificing quality.

  • Maintain strong design taste so motion and visuals align with Darkroom branding.


End‑to‑end ownership



  • Take a reference, script, brief, or rough direction and run with it independently.

  • Manage projects from first cut to final export, including file organization and archiving for future reuse.

  • Collaborate with marketing, strategy, and creative leadership, while staying comfortable making calls when direction is loose.

  • Anticipate bottlenecks and propose clear solutions before they become problems.

  • Hit deadlines consistently without letting quality slip.


Social and performance awareness



  • Stay close to what is working on social right now, including trends, pacing, formats, and editing language.

  • Make creative decisions with performance and aesthetics in mind.

  • Use basic performance signals to inform how you cut, structure and hook content over time.


AI and workflow acceleration



  • Keep up with emerging tools that can speed up production, like transcription, captioning, audio cleanup, and smart cutdowns.

  • Adopt tools when useful, while keeping final output polished and human.


You Are a Great Fit If You



  • You have 3+ years of editing experience, with a real portfolio of short‑form work.

  • You can edit video and design motion in a way that feels native to social platforms.

  • You have strong mixed media instincts, balancing video, typography, and graphics without clutter.

  • You think like a producer. You do not wait for perfect inputs, you turn rough direction into finished work.

  • You understand hook design, pacing, rhythm and retention mechanics across social formats.

  • You are fast, organized, and steady under pressure, and you can run multiple projects at once.

  • You actively consume social media and can explain why something worked, not just that it worked.

  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well and collaborate with speed and low friction.

  • You care about craft, but you care even more about impact.


Bonus If You



  • You have edited for creators, founders, agencies or brand‑led thought leadership channels.

  • You have worked on performance creative and can connect edits to outcomes.

  • You have experience capturing and editing event content for social distribution.

  • You have built repeatable motion systems or template libraries.

  • You have explored AI tools for editing, motion, or production automation.


What It’s Like To Work At Darkroom


We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:



  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.


Job Details

  • Employment type: Full‑time

  • Job function: Marketing, Public Relations, and Writing/Editing

  • Industries: Advertising Services

Art Lead - NFL Universe Football

Join to apply for the Art Lead - NFL Universe Football role at Voldex.

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox’s top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 145 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 75+ full‑time remote team members across the globe.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a small team of artists, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and fostering a positive, creative work environment

  • Highly organized and process oriented, needs to be able to think in scale and systems to help level up the Art team

Nice to Have

  • Experience collaborating with game designers and product teams to understand art request details and flag risks or needs for additional information

Tech Stack

Sobre a Doctoralia

Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?

Somos a Doctoralia, empresa do grupo Docplanner, e estamos presentes em 13 países, sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 15 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês!

Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 10 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.

Nossa missão é "Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis".

Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos: marketplace, que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório, fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online. Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android.

Descrição da vaga

  • Responsável por apresentar as soluções B2B Doctoralia e Feegow ao mercado de saúde, atendendo clínicas e centros médicos;

  • Atualizar diariamente atividades e evoluções das contas de sua responsabilidade no CRM;
  • Negociar e fechar vendas dentro dos padrões de qualidade exigidos;

  • Conhecimento de vendas, técnicas de negociação e experiência em vendas internas;
  • Imprescindível experiência com utilização de CRM;

  • Habilidades em organização e gerenciamento do tempo;
  • Paixão por vendas;
  • Perfil adaptável a mudanças;
  • Motivado por metas;
  • Com pensamento de protagonista e que seja curioso e esteja disposto a aprender sempre.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, startup, SaaS ou vendas complexas;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com a técnica Spin Selling;
  • Curso superior completo;
  • Inglês avançado.

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores:
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro(a) de Implantação de Projetos Pleno que será responsável pela execução e gestão de obras na área de gás, como gasodutos, SCCs, pontos de entrega e recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros. A atuação será voltada ao acompanhamento técnico e operacional das obras, garantindo segurança, qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e integridade dos ativos.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar empresas contratadas na implantação das obras
  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos, priorizando segurança do trabalho e qualidade técnica
  • Oferecer suporte técnico às equipes contratadas, promovendo alta produtividade
  • Elaborar, revisar e consolidar documentos técnicos para contratação de serviços (memoriais descritivos, cartas-convite, RFPs, termos de abertura)
  • Definir estratégias de contratação alinhadas às prioridades da NTS e aos requisitos dos projetos
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Engenharia

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de acompanhamento de cronogramas (MS Project, Excel, Primavera)

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.

  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations. We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions, storage operations in Preá, and final-mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply-chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

  • Mid‑Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  • Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  • Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  • Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  • Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  • Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  • Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  • Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  • Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe)
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia's standards for quality, specifications, and finishes

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes)
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá‑Jericoacoara transfers

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred)
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus)
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable
  • Portuguese and English a must—any other language a plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports)
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs)

Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Join to apply for the College Research Administration Manager role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary POC for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. This position reports to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance, while a dotted‑line reporting relationship with the Associate Dean for Research aligns day‑to‑day priorities. External contacts include representatives from federal agencies, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multi‑tasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization; strong organizational and time management skills; exceptional attention to detail; and the ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team requiring coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency requests.
  • Must be able to speak confidently when communicating with investigators and internal and external research stakeholders; excellent customer service skills; outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; and the ability to write and interpret technical contract language, understand its implications, and effectively communicate with and serve as liaisons between granting agencies, university administration, and the principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or other related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross‑functional, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description cannot be construed as a contract for employment.

About The Role

We are looking for an innovative Learning Designer with 3‑5 years of experience to focus on the development and creation of high‑quality, engaging digital learning content for our global employee base. You will be the team’s e‑learning expert and creative visual designer, turning instructional concepts into polished, interactive learning experiences.

Reporting to the Global Head of People Development, this role is perfect for a self‑starter who is passionate about leveraging new technologies, especially Generative AI tools, to build content that is visually compelling, scalable, and highly effective. You will directly support the development of core programs across leadership, onboarding, and emerging capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and publish responsive and engaging e‑learning courses using industry‑leading authoring tools like Articulate Rise/Storyline and Evolve.
  • Translate training needs and Subject Matter Expert (SME) content into visually compelling and effective storyboards and interactive modules.
  • Apply instructional design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) to ensure learning objectives are met and content is outcome‑focused.
  • Build comprehensive e‑learning and core skills content serving all employees on communication, productivity, and professional development.
  • Serve as the visual design expert for the People Development team, creating high‑quality, on‑brand graphics, slide decks, and visual aids using tools like Canva and PowerPoint.
  • Produce and edit multimedia content, including simple video, audio, and animations, to enhance digital learning assets.
  • Ensure all final learning products are visually polished, meet high‑quality standards, and represent the function with excellence.
  • Actively explore and pilot the use of Generative AI and emerging technologies (e.g., HeyGen, Synthesia, WellSaid Labs) to accelerate content creation, localization, and personalization of learning assets.
  • Partner with the People Development Partner team to develop content for emerging capability training, including AI and digital fluency.
  • Coordinate with regional People Development colleagues to support the localization and deployment of e‑learning content via the Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Partner with SMEs and internal stakeholders to gather content and ensure technical and functional accuracy.
  • Support the content governance process, including version control and content lifecycle management.

Essential

  • 3‑5 years of hands‑on experience in a Learning Designer, E‑learning Developer, or Instructional Design role.
  • Proficiency in at least one rapid e‑learning authoring tool (Articulate Rise 360 preferred).
  • Strong visual design skills with proficiency in Canva, PowerPoint, or similar graphic design tools.
  • Solid understanding of instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles.
  • Experience or strong interest in using AI‑powered tools (e.g., Synthesia, Jasper AI, HeyGen) for content creation.
  • Experience with Articulate Storyline 360 or similar advanced authoring tools.
  • Experience using the Evolve authoring tool.
  • Background in digital, technology, or professional services industries.
  • Technical capabilities: instructional design methodologies and assessment design; e‑learning authoring tools (Articulate Rise/Storyline, Evolve, Adobe Captivate); video editing and multimedia content creation; LMS administration and content publishing.

Personal Attributes

  • Innovation Orientation—eager to explore new technologies and methodologies.
  • Quality Obsession—maintaining high standards for visual and functional content excellence.
  • Learning Agility—mastering new content domains quickly and staying current on trends.
  • Collaborative Spirit—partnering effectively with team members and SMEs.
